resources.string: Dynamic Vibration will enhance your media experience with vibrations when playing a movie, video, or listening to music

How to Use

You can adjust the Dynamic Vibration effect for each media app.
Start an app and play the content of your choice, then swipe down the Quick Settings panel, tap on the tile and select an effect.
Putting the slider to the left will delay the vibrations while putting it to the right will make the device vibrate earlier.

Tips

This feature is available while Dynamic Vibration is turned on in the XperiaLabs Settings or via the Quick Settings tile.
